settings.label: What comes in the kit?
settings.content: Every kit includes pre-cut materials, the substructure, deck blocks, hardware, and step-by-step instructions. You get what you need to assemble the deck without guessing.

settings.label: What tools do I need to install the deck kit?
settings.content: A drill is the main tool. The install stays simple, with no cutting, measuring, or special tools required.

settings.label: How long does it take to build a deck?
settings.content: Many customers assemble their deck the same day. Build time depends on site prep, surface level, and how many people help.

settings.label: Do I need a permit?
settings.content: Permit rules vary by city and county. Check your local building authority before you start, and we can support your plan during the design consultation.

settings.label: Can I build on uneven ground or elevate the deck?
settings.content: Yes. Many builds use adjustments for slope and elevation. Tell us your yard conditions, and we will guide the best setup during your free consult.

settings.label: Can I set this up on grass, dirt, or pavers?
settings.content: Yes, with the right base. A solid, level surface helps long-term performance, so prep depends on your yard and drainage.

settings.label: Pressure-treated wood vs composite, which should I choose?
settings.content: Choose pressure-treated if you want a classic wood deck at a lower starting price. Choose composite if you want a wood look with lower maintenance and strong fade and splinter resistance.

settings.label: Do your kits handle heavy backyard use?
settings.content: These are professional-grade deck kits built for real outdoor living, including gatherings and furniture. If you plan concentrated loads like hot tubs, tell us up front so we can guide the right approach.

settings.label: Do you offer financing?
settings.content: Yes. Build now, pay later options are available with flexible plans. Financing is subject to credit approval and terms apply.
